sources.publisher: Tribunal Electoral / Diario Oficial de la Federación
sources.title: 8 August 2018: final presidential election determination, birth record and constitutional term
sources.findings: Read the Electoral Tribunal determination dated 8 August 2018 in the DOF, especially eligibility paragraphs 130–134 and final declarations. It explicitly confirms birth on 13 November 1953, election victory, the Morena/PT/PES coalition and constitutional term from 1 December 2018 through 30 September 2024. The certified birth-record finding is not a separate inspection of the original birth certificate. Do not infer blanket personal probity from the eligibility discussion.

sources.title: Andrés Manuel López Obrador: political biography and succession update
sources.findings: Read CIDOB political biography and its succession update. Main narrative is dated 29 November 2018; update names Claudia Sheinbaum as successor on 1 October 2024. Distinguish handover from legal final day, and do not treat the old main text as a current office record. Earlier PRD leadership, Federal District office and unsuccessful 2006/2012 campaigns are corroborated. Self-proclaimed legitimate presidency was not constitutional office. Charged editorial descriptions and the apparent 2008 heading typo are not adopted.

sources.title: UNAM-DGCS-440: indexed extract confirming degree awarded on 12 November 1987
sources.findings: Read the search-indexed UNAM-DGCS-440 extract explicitly confirming a licenciatura in Ciencias Políticas y Administración Pública on 12 November 1987 after university requirements were met. Direct opens failed with 502/timeouts, so this is an indexed primary-source extract, not a complete bulletin inspection. Both display text and review preserve that limit. Do not confuse 1970s study dates with degree award or call it a doctorate.

sources.title: 2018 candidacy record: Morena movement, council and executive committee roles
sources.findings: Read the two-page 2018 INE-hosted candidate submission, including the career section. It distinguishes Morena movement formation in 2011, national council presidency in 2012, party registration in 2014 and executive committee presidency from 2015. It is candidate-supplied material; allegations of election fraud and campaign promises are not presented as adjudicated facts or completed achievements.

sources.title: Morena statute resolution quoting 9 July registration and 1 August 2014 legal effect
sources.findings: Read the Electoral Tribunal-hosted INE resolution, antecedent III and quoted first operative provision of INE/CG94/2014. Registration was approved on 9 July 2014 with constitutive effect on 1 August. These are separate dates and neither is substituted for the earlier movement formation.

sources.title: Informe sobre las elecciones de 2024 en México: government performance and social policy
sources.findings: Read International IDEA retrospective government-performance section, including cash transfers and real minimum-wage growth. It assesses economic results as mixed and attributes a contribution to poverty reduction to these policies. This is an attributed analytical assessment, not proof of exclusive personal causation. Different poverty measures and periods are not conflated; no numeric poverty series is reproduced.

sources.title: 15 September 2024: constitutional judicial reform and transitional provisions
sources.findings: Read the official judicial reform decree, its publication/signature date and first two transitional provisions. The decree was issued on 15 September 2024 and entered into force the following day. Publication is neither immediate entry into force nor a completed judicial election. The legal change is distinguished from political claims about its benefits or risks.

sources.title: 15 September 2024: judicial reform supporters and critics
sources.findings: Read Reuters reporting syndicated on Investing.com, including paragraphs on López Obrador’s stated rationale and critics’ concern about judicial political independence. Both remain attributed views. The report says the reform took effect on Sunday; the primary decree’s next-day clause controls the dossier date instead. No independent validation of either side’s predictions is claimed.

sources.title: 28 October 2026: López Obrador’s message following the death of Cuauhtémoc Cárdenas
sources.findings: Read El Financiero’s 28 October 2026 report, including the quoted condolence message attributed to López Obrador following Cuauhtémoc Cárdenas’s death. This supports a reported written public communication after leaving office, not an in-person appearance, health assessment or inspection of his original social-media account.

sources.title: López Obrador biography: corroborating earlier offices and 2018 inauguration; erroneous end date excluded
sources.findings: Read the one-page Museo de los Presidentes Coahuilenses biography. Earlier PRD and Federal District roles and 1 December 2018 inauguration corroborate other sources. Its claimed 14 October 2024 presidential end date is erroneous against the electoral ruling and succession record; its stray 1797–1867 line is unrelated. Its 1973–1976 parenthetical cannot establish the degree award date. These errors are explicitly excluded.
